issue.title: sase-core flake: federation_worker listener_creates_private_socket_and_rejects_symlink fails under the parallel sase-core gate

task_type_fields.evidence: Proposed by sase-1g4.4 note #8 (epic sase-1g4, model-core phase, 2026-10-05) and filed by the sase-1g4 land agent. During `sase tool run check` in sase-core (commit 16095fcf plus the builtin effort-completion test), sase_gateway failed in two runs. Each run failed a different test: once a sudo_runner dispatch ETXTBSY (already tracked as sase-15h), and once this federation_worker IPC test about socket symlink rejection. Both passed when rerun alone on the same tree. The phase did not touch sase_gateway. Observed fail rate: 1 of 2 parallel gate runs. It did not reproduce serially. The phase note did not record the exact assertion text. Start by running the test in a loop under parallel load and checking whether the listener's socket-path recovery (federation_worker/imp/listener.rs recover_socket_target) races with a shared temp dir.

issue.creation_reason: Phase sase-1g4.4 saw this sase_gateway IPC test fail once under the loaded parallel sase-core gate and pass alone. No existing task names this node.

payload.entry: Related: sase-15h (the same sase-1g4.4 parallel sase-core gate run also hit the sudo_runner ETXTBSY flake tracked there). Typed related link not recorded because sase artifact link add currently fails with sase-1gs.
